Game Overview

Noob vs Hacker Gold Apple puts players into a two-player experience centered on race against time in "Noob vs Hacker Gold Apple," a vibrant two-player platformer where speed and strategy reign supreme. Collect golden apples to grow stronger, but beware of poisonous ones that shrink you. Outmaneuver your opponent and master the shrinking mechanic to triumph in thrilling, heart-racing 120-second rounds.
